title: mTLS tested with a real peer (both halves), and an interop-day test plan
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Before the interop day; Mark offered to do it with Rohan and Konrad. Both halves exist (PKIX inbound mimid-75nk.5, outbound client identity; DANE mimid-75nk.6) but were never deployed or tested with a peer. Write the test plan (which peer, CA or DANE records, which mechanisms, expected results) and run it on the January/December host (mimid-1wgh.46.20.1).
notes: 2026-11-22: one of the three remaining items is ANSWERED. 'Check reviewcommit.com is DNSSEC-signed at Epik before offering DANE' -- it is. Verified from joumon: DS at the parent (25774 13 2 CCECA9CA...), resolvers set the ad flag, and the provider key TXT RRset carries an RRSIG by key 25774. So DANE is offerable on our side as far as the zone goes. What is still missing for DANE is the record itself: no TLSA at _mimi._client.mimi.reviewcommit.com (checked, empty), so mimid publishes no DANE client-certificate record yet. That is optional -- the RFC 9421 DNS-key mechanism is primary and works -- and only matters if a peer wants to authenticate us by DANE. Remaining: the real-peer test, and DANE through real DNSSEC.
